request: how many 50 cm tiles cover a 4 m by 3 m floor?

beats.intent: A 4 m by 3 m floor outline
beats.narration: The floor is four metres by three.
beats.code:
stage.title("Tiling a floor")
k = 1.2
floor = Rectangle(width=4 * k, height=3 * k, color=WHITE).move_to([-1.0, -0.4, 0])
stage.play(Create(floor))
stage.add(floor)
stage.label(floor, "4 m", direction=DOWN)
stage.label(floor, "3 m", direction=LEFT)

beats.intent: One row of 8 tiles along the 4 m side
beats.narration: A tile is half a metre, so eight fit along the four metre side.
beats.code:
t = 0.5 * k
row = VGroup(*[Square(t, color=GREY_B, fill_color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.6) for _ in range(8)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0).align_to(floor, DL)
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(s) for s in row], lag_ratio=0.1))
stage.add(row)
stage.caption("8 along")

beats.intent: Six rows filling the floor, 48 tiles
beats.narration: Six rows fit up the three metre side.
beats.code:
rows = VGroup(*[row.copy().shift(r * t * UP) for r in range(1, 6)])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(r) for r in rows], lag_ratio=0.2))
stage.add(rows)
stage.caption("6 rows")

beats.narration: Eight times six: forty eight tiles. Buy a few extra for the cuts.

request: what's the difference between speed and acceleration?

beats.intent: A car on a road with a speedometer reading 0
beats.narration: A car pulls away from a traffic light.
beats.code:
stage.title("Acceleration")
road = Line([-6, -0.6, 0], [6, -0.6, 0], color=GREY_B)
car = RoundedRectangle(width=1.4, height=0.6, corner_radius=0.15, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.7).move_to([-5, -0.2, 0])
stage.play(Create(road), FadeIn(car))
stage.add(road, car)

beats.intent: The car at four moments one second apart, getting further apart each time, with speeds 0, 3, 6, 9 m/s
beats.narration: Each second it goes three metres a second faster: zero, three, six, nine.
beats.code:
xs = [-5 + 0.65 * d for d in (0, 1.5, 6, 13.5)]
ghosts = VGroup(*[car.copy().set_opacity(0.35 + 0.2 * k).move_to([x, -0.2, 0]) for k, x in enumerate(xs[1:])])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(g) for g in ghosts], lag_ratio=0.4))
stage.add(ghosts)
for x, v in zip(xs, (0, 3, 6, 9)):
    stage.add(Text(f"{v} m/s", font_size=22, color=YELLOW).move_to([x, 0.6, 0]))
stage.caption("speed: how fast; acceleration: how fast the speed changes")

beats.intent: Axes of time and speed with the line v = 3t
beats.narration: Plot speed against time: a straight line rising three every second.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(0, 4), y_range=(0, 12), labels=("seconds", "m/s"))
g = plot_graph(stage, ax, lambda t: 3 * t, color=ORANGE)
pts = plot_points(stage, ax, [(0, 0), (1, 3), (2, 6), (3, 9)])

beats.intent: The slope marked as a rise of 3 for each 1 across, beside a = 3 m/s²
beats.narration: That slope is the acceleration: three metres per second, every second.
beats.code:
run = draw_line(stage, ax.c2p(1, 3), ax.c2p(2, 3), color=GREEN)
rise = draw_line(stage, ax.c2p(2, 3), ax.c2p(2, 6), color=YELLOW)
stage.label(rise, "3", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)
stage.equation(r"a = \frac{\Delta v}{\Delta t} = 3\ \text{m/s}^2")

request: how do you add 5 and 3 in binary?

beats.intent: The numbers 101 and 011 lined up under place values 8 4 2 1
beats.narration: Five is one-zero-one in binary, three is zero-one-one. Line them up under the place values.
beats.code:
stage.title("5 + 3 in binary")
cols = [-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5]
for x, v in zip(cols, (8, 4, 2, 1)):
    stage.add(Text(str(v), font_size=24, color=GREY_B).move_to([x, 2.0, 0]))
a = VGroup(*[Text(d, font_size=40).move_to([x, 1.1, 0]) for x, d in zip(cols, "0101")])
b = VGroup(*[Text(d, font_size=40).move_to([x, 0.3, 0]) for x, d in zip(cols, "0011")])
plus = Text("+", font_size=40).move_to([-2.4, 0.3, 0])
line = Line([-2.2, -0.2, 0], [2.0, -0.2, 0], color=WHITE)
stage.play(FadeIn(a), FadeIn(b), FadeIn(plus), Create(line))
stage.add(a, b, plus, line)

beats.intent: The ones column: 1 + 1 = 10, writing 0 and carrying 1
beats.narration: Ones column: one plus one is two, which in binary is one-zero. Write nought, carry one.
beats.code:
r1 = Text("0", font_size=40, color=YELLOW).move_to([1.5, -0.8, 0])
c1 = Text("1", font_size=24, color=RED).move_to([0.5, 1.7, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(r1), FadeIn(c1))
stage.add(r1, c1)

beats.intent: The carries rippling left: twos column 1 + 1 = 10, fours column 1 + 1 = 10, giving 1000
beats.narration: Twos: the carry plus one is two again: nought, carry one. Fours: the same. The last carry lands in the eights.
beats.code:
r2 = Text("0", font_size=40, color=YELLOW).move_to([0.5, -0.8, 0])
c2 = Text("1", font_size=24, color=RED).move_to([-0.5, 1.7, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(r2), FadeIn(c2))
r3 = Text("0", font_size=40, color=YELLOW).move_to([-0.5, -0.8, 0])
r4 = Text("1", font_size=40, color=YELLOW).move_to([-1.5, -0.8, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(r3), FadeIn(r4))
stage.add(r2, c2, r3, r4)

beats.narration: One-zero-zero-zero: eight. Five plus three is eight, as it should be.

request: how much CO2 does a 100 km car trip make?

beats.intent: A car with a 100 km trip arrow
beats.narration: A car drives a hundred kilometres.
beats.code:
stage.title("CO₂ from a car trip")
car = RoundedRectangle(width=1.4, height=0.6, corner_radius=0.15, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.7).move_to([-4.5, 0.5, 0])
trip = Arrow([-3.6, 0.5, 0], [4.5, 0.5, 0], buff=0, color=GREY_B)
stage.play(FadeIn(car), GrowArrow(trip))
stage.add(car, trip)
stage.label(trip, "100 km", direction=UP)

beats.intent: Small puffs along the route, one per km, each labelled 120 g
beats.narration: A typical petrol car emits about a hundred and twenty grams of carbon dioxide each kilometre.
beats.code:
puffs = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.12, color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=0.5).move_to([x, 0.0, 0]) for x in np.linspace(-3.4, 4.2, 20)])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(p) for p in puffs], lag_ratio=0.05))
stage.add(puffs)
stage.caption("about 120 g of CO₂ every km")

beats.intent: Bars of CO2 for the trip: car 12 kg, train 3.5 kg, bike 0
beats.narration: Over a hundred kilometres that's twelve kilograms. The same trip by train is about three and a half; by bike, almost nothing.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
b = draw_bars(stage, [12, 3.5, 0.05], labels=["car", "train", "bike"], color=GREY_B)
stage.caption("kg of CO₂ for 100 km")

beats.intent: The bars beside 100 × 120 g = 12 000 g = 12 kg
beats.narration: A hundred times a hundred and twenty grams is twelve thousand grams: twelve kilograms.
